page_findings.599: Distinguish programmed/descriptive dynamics,technician fader and performer dynamics;nonstandard bracket meaning must be defined. Shared barlines imply coordination; omit electronic bars only when no synchrony required.
page_findings.600: State close/approximate/independent coordination; timing landmarks help rehearsal. Cumulative times for performer only when that player follows a clock; otherwise local durations.
page_findings.601: Trigger keyboard may need written keys even when resulting sound differs; cue/tuning readers need actual sounds,identified separately. No automatic pitch correction between roles.
page_findings.602: Separate sounding cue from trigger action. MIDI sequence trigger must align precise event; splitting rests can locate it. Show only useful sequence excerpt forsecure subsequent entry.
page_findings.603: Cue-to-player guide relates sequence to later entry. Delay score can condense background only preserving coordination; distinct input/output/feedback and continuous processing controls remain explicit.
page_findings.604: Program changes at actual points,also reminders at passage/page boundaries when useful;short description aids setup. Manual control placement depends operating hand;technician operations atbottom.
page_findings.605: Defined graphic scales show controller state and aid mid-passage recovery. Pitch-bend grid zero/range must be stated;displayed output pitch and level have different defined dimensions.
page_findings.606: Complete Harvey Advaya example: separate cello,harmonizer,CD1,CD2 tracks;framed operational symbols differ from rehearsalK;explicit approximate positions,dashed cue guide and fades. No full pitch/performance reconstruction.
